library_preparation_preflight.summary: SFTP adapter behavior requires a reachable SFTP server; use an embedded Apache MINA SSHD server rather than Docker or extra dependencies.
library_preparation_preflight.agent_guidance: Create an in-process SshServer on an ephemeral port with SftpSubsystemFactory, password authentication, a temporary VirtualFileSystemFactory root, and allowUnknownKeys=true in DefaultSftpSessionFactory. Exercise inbound, outbound, and gateway flows. The target artifact already brings Apache MINA SSHD transitively. See the official [SFTP documentation](https://www.springframework.org/spring-integration/reference/sftp.html) and [project test support](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-integration/blob/main/spring-integration-sftp/src/test/java/org/springframework/integration/sftp/SftpTestSupport.java).
risks: Without the embedded server, tests are likely limited to construction/configuration coverage and will miss meaningful file-transfer behavior.
Native Image verification may expose additional reflection or dynamic-access requirements after the integration tests are added.
